title: eryngium campestre var. virens
intro: Eryngium campestre var. virens, commonly known as the field eryngium or green-veined eryngium, is a plant species within the Apiaceae family. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit sedative effects. The bioactive constituents of Eryngium campestre var. virens include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
